verdict.rationale: OpenClaw is explicitly self-hosted ('Run one Gateway process on your own machine and message your AI assistant from anywhere' and 'Self-hosted gateway'), which inherently lets a user choose the physical location/region where their data and Gateway state live. However, there is no explicit documentation addressing data residency/region controls as a feature (e.g., named regions, compliance certifications, or region-pinning for cloud components like ClawHub or model providers). Missing for 10: explicit region/residency configuration options, documentation of where third-party model providers or ClawHub store data, and any compliance-oriented residency guarantees.
